title_zh: 决定弱化奇幻剧中的惊吓场景

scenario.label_zh: 调整奇幻剧的惊吓场景
scenario.goal_zh: 核对奇幻剧角色的区别，并约定以影子替代尖叫和突然现身

context_zh: 社区剧团为适合较年轻观众的奇幻剧排练讨论舞台效果。
author: author-phase10-c

sentences.speaker: Cleo
sentences.text: Is the creature in this scene supposed to be the devil?

sentences.speaker: Jasper
sentences.text: No. In this story it is a demon guarding a bridge, not the ruler of the underworld.

sentences.speaker: Cleo
sentences.text: The sudden scream is disturbing. Our younger audience members may find it too much.

sentences.speaker: Jasper
sentences.text: How else could we depict the creature without removing the danger from the scene?

sentences.speaker: Cleo
sentences.text: We could show its shadow across the bridge and let the traveller notice it.

sentences.speaker: Jasper
sentences.text: I like that. We will cut the scream and the sudden entrance, and use a shadow instead.

sentences.speaker: Cleo
sentences.text: Agreed. I will rehearse the traveller's reaction to the shadow.
